The billing contract requires cancelled rows to be ignored, discount to be floored, shipping to depend on discounted net and the supplied free-shipping threshold, and total to include that net. It also requires every result to be zero when no active rows remain. The replacement uses the passed configuration values, handles an empty or fully cancelled list, and uses filter/reduce without modifying the input rows."}
